name: zcode-agent-cluster
description: ZCAC — multi-agent coding cluster orchestration on top of the ZCode Agent Runtime (task graph, scheduler, agent pool, review loop, git worktree isolation).

zcacModel.title: Default model (fallback for all roles)
zcacModel.description: Logical model id providerId/modelId[@reasoningLevel] used when no role-specific model is set

zcacModelPlanner.title: Planner model
zcacModelPlanner.description: Model for the planner role (task decomposition). Leave empty to use default.

zcacModelCoder.title: Coder model
zcacModelCoder.description: Model for coder workers (code implementation). Leave empty to use default.

zcacModelTester.title: Tester model
zcacModelTester.description: Model for tester workers (run tests). Leave empty to use default.

zcacModelReviewer.title: Reviewer model
zcacModelReviewer.description: Model for reviewer workers (code review). Leave empty to use default.

zcacModelExplorer.title: Explorer model
zcacModelExplorer.description: Model for explorer workers (read-only analysis). Leave empty to use default.

zcacIsolation.title: Workspace isolation
zcacIsolation.description: shared (workers share the workspace) or worktree (each write task gets its own git worktree, merged back on success)

zcacConcurrency.title: Max concurrent tasks
zcacConcurrency.description: Global task concurrency for the cluster scheduler
